t: This is the East Stand at Highbury Stadium in Islington, a former football stand. It was designed by William Binnie, a Scottish architect who trained in Scotland and first practised in New York before moving to London. In the First World War he served with the Black Watch and was decorated for bravery. Afterwards he worked for the Imperial War Graves Commission until 1927, when he returned to private practice in London. So the designer of this stand had a career that took in New York, the trenches and war cemeteries.
